caption: The drawing contains two separate rectangular patterns centered on a plain light beige background. The top rectangle has a horizontally oriented design with three main bands. The outer bands feature a brick-red color with olive green geometric forms and small white cross motifs. The middle band has a peachy-orange background, decorated with stylized floral elements, each with green leaves, a white central flower surrounded by red accents, and outlined in black. Thin black-and-white chevron patterns divide the bands. The lower rectangle displays a grid-like pattern, mainly in beige and light brown, with the vertical and horizontal lines forming rectangular cells. Inside some of these cells are small motifs consisting of black and white circular shapes and tiny red elements resembling flowers or berries, evenly spaced across the pattern. Toward the lower right corner of the image, the name “Lon Cronk” is handwritten in black ink.
title: Printed Cotton
